name: imswitch-plugin-example-ui
comment: Every package the ImSwitch host shares is a peerDependency, NEVER a
dependency. The host supplies them at runtime through the Module
Federation share scope. Listing one under `dependencies` is how a second
React ends up on the page, which fails as an unreadable hooks error at
mount time. `make check` and CI both reject it.
They are repeated under devDependencies so a fresh clone can build and run
the dev server. That copy is never emitted into dist/, because
webpack.config.js declares them shared with `import: false`.
